observation.evaluation:
Correctness: PARTIALLY_CORRECT
Safety: CAUTION
Issues: Lateral chest radiograph with both clavicles superimposed, so left-vs-right clavicle laterality cannot be reliably determined; the “L” marker in the upper-left is a projection marker, not evidence of a left clavicle deformity; no frontal view is provided to confirm a side-specific finding.
Suggestion: Report laterality as indeterminate on this lateral view and recommend a frontal/AP radiograph for confirmation; do not use the “L” marker to assign clavicle pathology to the left side.
